title: Shows like We're Alive
description: Survival-heavy routes where group decisions, attrition, and constant threat matter more than polish alone.
label: Endurance pressure

showReasons.impact-winter: Keeps the survival pressure high while leaning harder into cinematic genre spectacle.
showReasons.end-of-all-hope: A more spacefaring branch that still treats survival like the main engine.
showReasons.the-phenomenon: For listeners who want the relentless public-danger scale and constant threat turnover.
showReasons.the-white-vault: A colder, more isolated route if the harsh-environment angle is the main draw.
showReasons.borrasca: A darker small-town menace branch for listeners who want dread and discovery over action.
showReasons.malevolent: A more occult escalation if the listener wants pressure, darkness, and momentum above all else.
